description:
The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE), Rock Island District (MVR), intends to issue a Request for Quotes (RFQ) for Trailer Mounted 1600 CFM Oil Free Diesel Rotary Screw Compressor for the Mississippi River Project Office (MRPO).

This pre-solicitation notice is for informational purposes only and is not to be construed as a commitment by the Government to procure any supplies or services, or for the Government to pay for the information received. No reimbursement will be made for any costs associated with providing information to response to this pre-solicitation notice or any follow up information requested. Consequently, no solicitation is being issued at this time. Therefore, no award will be made as a result of providing this information.
